Maxime nunc salvet te in omnibus urbibus: now especially let him save thee in all thy cities
et iudices tui de quibus dixisti: Mihi d: and thy judges, of whom thou saidst: Give me kings and princes
Dabo tibi regem: I will give thee a king
Colligata est iniquitas Ephraim, abscond: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up, his sin is hidden
Dolores parturientis venient ei,: The sorrows of a woman in labour shall come upon him
he shall not stand in the breach of the children
De manu mortis liberabo eos,: I will deliver them out of the hand of death
DE MANU MORTIS: out of the hand of death
O death, I will be thy death
Consolatio abscondita est ab oculis meis: comfort is hidden from my eyes
inter fratres dividet,: shall make a separation between brothers
de deserto ascendentem,: that shall rise from the desert
et siccabit venas: and it shall dry up … springs
et desolabit fontem eius: and shall make his fountain desolate
Pereat Samaria, quoniam ad amaritudinem: Let Samaria perish, because she hath stirred up her God to bitterness
pereant, parvuli eorum allidantur: let them perish …, let their little ones be dashed
and let the women with child be ripped up
for thou hast fallen down by thy iniquity
et dicite ei: Omnem aufer iniquitatem: and say to him: Take away all iniquity
and we will render the calves of our lips
super equum non ascendemus,: we will not ride upon horses
nec dicemus ultra dii nostri opera manuu: neither will we say any more: The works of our hands are our gods
quia eius qui in te est misereberis: for thou wilt have mercy on … that is in thee
Ero quasi ros,: I will be as the dew
Israel germinabit quasi lilium: Israel shall spring as the lily
and his root shall shoot forth as that of Libanus
et erit quasi oliva gloria eius: and his glory shall be as the olive tree
and his smell as that of Libanus
Convertentur sedentes in umbra eius,: They shall be converted that sit under his shadow
Ephraim quid mihi ultra idola ?: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols?
et dirigam eum: and I will make him flourish
from me is thy fruit found
et intelliget ista ?: and he shall understand these things?
et sciet hec ?: and he shall know these things?
Quia recte vie Domini: for the ways of the Lord are right
and the just shall walk in them
